Title: VOCALOID™6 Voicebank ZOLA Project

Commemorating the 10th Anniversary of its Release with a Remake of the Male Trio Voicebank
Digital Sales Begin Today
Yamaha Corporation announces the release of the "ZOLA Project" voicebank for VOCALOID6. Starting from June 20, the new voicebank is available for purchases (download only) from the official VOCALOID SHOP (https://www.vocaloid.com/en/).
Developed by Yamaha in 2003, VOCALOID singing voice synthesis technology and software creates vocals for songs using lyrics and melodies as input. Synthesizing different vocals is as simple as switching between voicebanks, which are generated from actual human voices. Released in October 2022, VOCALOID6 features the VOCALOID:AI synthesis engine, which uses artificial intelligence to synthesize more natural, richly expressive singing voices. VOCALOID songs created using VOCALOID technology have sparked a new generation of music, boasting countless fans and listeners around the world.
This new remake of the "ZOLA Project" voicebank for VOCALOID6 was produced by Yamaha's SoundUD team to commemorate the 10th anniversary of the release of the original voicebank for VOCALOID3, which debuted on June 20, 2013. Like the original, the new version includes voicebank data for a group of three male characters: KYO, YUU, and WIL. However, for this release, vocal data from the artist behind the KYO character voice has been newly recorded, while VOCALOID3 voicebank data and sound has been used to revamp the voices of YUU and WIL for use with VOCALOID6. More natural and richly expressive than ever before, the voices can be mixed and matched freely to sing solos, duos, or as a group, and can even be used in combination with other voicebanks. The possible musical variations are endless, limited only by the imagination of the creator. The voices can sing lyrics naturally in not only Japanese, but English and Chinese as well. The official "ZOLA Project" demo song "BORDERLESS" was created by renowned Japanese composer Daisuke Asakura and songwriter Yukinojo Mori.

## Overview
1.   Voicebank with three male voices that can be mixed and matched freely to sing solos, duos, or in chorus  
2.   Newly recorded data for KYO and revamped data for YUU and WIL for richer, more expressive singing voices  
3.   Sing lyrics in English and Chinese naturally with support for multilingual singing

| Voicebank ZOLA Project | USD 99 | June 20 |

## Key Features
### 1. Voicebank with three male voices that can be mixed and matched freely to sing solos, duos, or in chorus
The "ZOLA Project" voicebank consists of the voices of characters KYO, YUU, and WIL, who make up a three-person male vocal group. Take advantage of the individuality of these three unique voices to enjoy creating VOCALOID songs using a single voicebank. Mix and match the voices freely to sing solos, duos, as a three-person group, or in chorus with other voices when used in combination with other voicebanks. The possible musical variations are endless, limited only by the imagination of the creator. The qualities and specialty genres for each voice are listed below.
| No. | Character Name | Voice Qualities |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| 1 | KYO | Bright and positive Specialty genres: Pop, Rock, Electronic |  
| 2 | YUU | Soft and ephemeral Specialty genres: Pop, Dance, Jazz |  
| 3 | WIL | Moderate and husky Specialty genres: Pop, R&B, Ballads |

## Key Features
### 2. Newly recorded data for KYO and revamped data for YUU and WIL for richer, more expressive singing voices
For this release, vocal data from the artist behind the character KYO has been newly recorded, while VOCALOID3 voicebank data and sound has been used to revamp the voices of YUU and WIL for use with VOCALOID6. The voicebank uses the VOCALOID:AI synthesis engine of VOCALOID6 to synthesize singing voices that are more natural and richly expressive than ever before.

## Key Features
### 3. Sing lyrics in English and Chinese naturally with support for multilingual singing
The "ZOLA Project" voicebank offers multilingual functionality for singing lyrics in not only Japanese, but English and Chinese as well, using natural, native-like pronunciation. When a user inputs English or Chinese lyrics, the language is automatically detected and the lyrics are sung using natural pronunciation, giving creators more freedom when writing lyrics, without having to worry about language barriers. The voicebank also supports VOCALO CHANGER, which uses the creator's vocal data to replicate their own singing style as is.

## About "philo"
"philo" is a female singer known primarily for her vocal covers on social media. Her singing style is unique and unorthodox. She also arranges music for piano, which is her instrument of choice. Despite having only 2,000 Twitter followers at the time, philo's Tweet of herself singing Ado's "Odo" received 49,000 Likes. The post went viral, surpassing one million views, and her followers skyrocketed to over 20,000. Her cover of "God-ish" by PinocchioP rose to popularity based on word of mouth alone and achieved a ranking of #20 on LINE MUSIC.
*   Official YouTube Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@philo_zzz

## About "nana"
Developed and operated by nana music, Inc., nana is a music collaboration app that allows you to use your smartphone to record and post yourself singing or playing a musical instrument. Users can add layers of vocals or music to any sound posted on nana to create choral or acapella arrangements, band performances, and more, allowing them to enjoy music collaboration, anytime, anywhere. The app has approximately 10 million registered users.
*   Official Website: https://en.nana-music.com/  
*   Download for iOS: https://m.onelink.me/3542c96d  
*   Download for Android: https://m.onelink.me/bb721cad

To celebrate its release, the "Fuiro" voicebank will be available from May 9 until May 31 at a special introductory price of $45 (without tax), which is 50% off the regular price of $90 (without tax).
For more details, please visit the official VOCALOID SHOP: https://www.vocaloid.com/en/

## About the Vocals Audition
In February 2022, Yamaha hosted a vocals audition via the "nana" music collaboration app with the aim of introducing VOCALOID to a wider audience. The audition also provided an opportunity for the winner to have their vocals featured in a VOCALOID voicebank. "Taki Takota (philo)" was selected as the grand prize winner from among 3,182 valid entries based on her impressive singing skill and characteristic sound.

**Vocaloid****5**[[n 1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-2) is a singing vocal synthesizer and successor to Vocaloid 4 in the Vocaloid series. It was succeeded by Vocaloid 6.
On July 2, 2018, Yamaha announced that both the official Vocaloid website and shop would be temporarily shut down for maintenance on July 12, 2018, with several Vocaloid products scheduled for discontinuation.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-3) On the day of the maintenance, information on upcoming non-Yamaha vocal Haruno Sora was leaked through a preorder listing; the package was listed as an add-on for the then-unannounced Vocaloid 5.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-4) Several hours later, once the maintenance had been completed, Yamaha relaunched the Vocaloid website, officially revealing and releasing Vocaloid 5 at the same time.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:1-5)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:0-6)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-7)

Vocaloid 5 features a redesigned interface that has been described as "significantly more modern" than that of previous versions.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-8) It is the first release of Vocaloid to be exclusively sold as a bundle; all purchases include four default voicebanks - Amy, Chris, Kaori, and Ken. These voicebanks share a wide variety of preset audio samples, vocal samples, and singing styles, in both English and Japanese.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:3-9) Vocaloid 5 also offers finer control over many vocal functions; it includes several audio effects, editors, and parameters to manipulate output in ways that traditionally required the use of additional programs.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:3-9)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:2-10)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:4-11)
Vocaloid 5 requires a 64-bit operating system. Vocaloid 2 voicebanks are no longer officially supported, though voicebanks from Vocaloid 3 and newer are able to be used. Cross-synthesis (XSY) and job plug-ins do not function in Vocaloid 5.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:4-11)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-12)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-13)
The Vocaloid Editor for Cubase was updated to version 4.5 with the release of Vocaloid 5.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:1-5)
Amy is an English voicebank released as an integrated part of Vocaloid 5 on July 12, 2018. Her voice has been described as "expressive" and "versatile".[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:0-6)

Chris is an English voicebank released as an integrated part of Vocaloid 5 on July 12, 2018. His voice has been described as able to sing from "delicate, soft bass" to "powerful, sustained high tones".[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:0-6)
This voicebank is a minor update to the Cyber Diva package.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:5-14) It was released on July 12, 2018.
This voicebank is a minor update to the Cyber Songman package.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:5-14) It was released on 2018.
Kaori is a Japanese voicebank released as an integrated part of Vocaloid 5 on July 12, 2018. Her voice has been described as "soulful".[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:0-6)
Ken is a Japanese voicebank released as an integrated part of Vocaloid 5 on July 12, 2018. His voice has been described as "sharp" and "clear" with a "light vocal quality".[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:0-6)
Main article: VY1
This voicebank is a minor update to the VY1v4 package.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:5-14) It was released on July 12, 2018. VY1 only includes VY1v4's "Normal" vocal.
Main article: VY2
This voicebank is a minor update to the VY2v3 package;[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:5-14) it primarily adds the "growl" function. It was released on July 12, 2018. VY2 only includes VY2v3's "Standard" vocal.

Haruno Sora is a voicebank for Vocaloid 5 and Voiceroid 2 developed by AH-Software and released on July 26, 2018. Her voice provider is Kikuko Inoue. The voicebank has two voice libraries, "Natural" and "Cool".[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-15)

### Meika Hime & Mikoto
[edit]
Meika Hime & Mikoto are two Vocaloid 5 voicebanks created by Gynoid Co., Ltd and sampled from the voice actress Kotori Koiwai.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-16)[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-17) They were released on March 30, 2019, along with text-to-speech software.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-18)

# Yamaha Releases "Po-uta" Voicebank for VOCALOID™6
## Product Overview
Developed by Yamaha in 2003, VOCALOID singing voice synthesis technology and software creates vocals for songs using lyrics and melodies as input. Synthesizing different vocals is as simple as switching between voicebanks, which are generated from actual human voices. Released in October 2022, VOCALOID6 features the VOCALOID:AI synthesis engine, which uses artificial intelligence to synthesize more natural, richly expressive singing voices. VOCALOID songs created using VOCALOID technology have sparked a new generation of music, boasting countless fans and listeners around the world.
The newly released "Po-uta" voicebank for VOCALOID6 allows users to enjoy creating vocals from artist Porter Robinson, who was nominated for Best Dance Recording in the 61st Annual GRAMMY Awards. The voicebank authentically reproduces the vocals used by Robinson in his own songs, which are known for their clarity and exquisite high range. This ensures a striking presence that won't be eclipsed, even by powerful music such as electronica. Using VOCALOID's "Style Presets" feature, users can also choose from thirteen singing style presets, approved by Robinson himself, to automatically adjust the vocal style, tone, and more. This makes it possible to recreate the vocals used in hits like "Shelter" or "Musician" with ease. The voicebank also supports new VOCALOID6 features, such as VOCALO CHANGER, which uses the creator's vocal data to replicate their own singing style as-is, and Multilingual, which makes it possible to sing lyrics in a mixture of fluent Japanese, English, and Chinese with a single voicebank.

Yamaha Corporation announces the release of the "ZOLA Project" voicebank for VOCALOID6. Starting from June 20, the new voicebank is available for purchases (download only) from the official VOCALOID SHOP (https://www.vocaloid.com/en/).

**Vocaloid****5**[[n 1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-2) is a singing vocal synthesizer and successor to Vocaloid 4 in the Vocaloid series. It was succeeded by Vocaloid 6.
On July 2, 2018, Yamaha announced that both the official Vocaloid website and shop would be temporarily shut down for maintenance on July 12, 2018, with several Vocaloid products scheduled for discontinuation.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-3) On the day of the maintenance, information on upcoming non-Yamaha vocal Haruno Sora was leaked through a preorder listing; the package was listed as an add-on for the then-unannounced Vocaloid 5.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-4) Several hours later, once the maintenance had been completed, Yamaha relaunched the Vocaloid website, officially revealing and releasing Vocaloid 5 at the same time.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:1-5)[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:0-6)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-7)

Vocaloid 5 features a redesigned interface that has been described as "significantly more modern" than that of previous versions.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-8) It is the first release of Vocaloid to be exclusively sold as a bundle; all purchases include four default voicebanks - Amy, Chris, Kaori, and Ken. These voicebanks share a wide variety of preset audio samples, vocal samples, and singing styles, in both English and Japanese.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:3-9) Vocaloid 5 also offers finer control over many vocal functions; it includes several audio effects, editors, and parameters to manipulate output in ways that traditionally required the use of additional programs.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:3-9)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:2-10)[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:4-11)
Vocaloid 5 requires a 64-bit operating system. Vocaloid 2 voicebanks are no longer officially supported, though voicebanks from Vocaloid 3 and newer are able to be used. Cross-synthesis (XSY) and job plug-ins do not function in Vocaloid 5.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-:4-11)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-12)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vocaloid_5#cite_note-13)

# Yamaha Releases "Po-uta" Voicebank for VOCALOID™6
## Product Overview
Developed by Yamaha in 2003, VOCALOID singing voice synthesis technology and software creates vocals for songs using lyrics and melodies as input. Synthesizing different vocals is as simple as switching between voicebanks, which are generated from actual human voices. Released in October 2022, VOCALOID6 features the VOCALOID:AI synthesis engine, which uses artificial intelligence to synthesize more natural, richly expressive singing voices. VOCALOID songs created using VOCALOID technology have sparked a new generation of music, boasting countless fans and listeners around the world.
The newly released "Po-uta" voicebank for VOCALOID6 allows users to enjoy creating vocals from artist Porter Robinson, who was nominated for Best Dance Recording in the 61st Annual GRAMMY Awards. The voicebank authentically reproduces the vocals used by Robinson in his own songs, which are known for their clarity and exquisite high range. This ensures a striking presence that won't be eclipsed, even by powerful music such as electronica. Using VOCALOID's "Style Presets" feature, users can also choose from thirteen singing style presets, approved by Robinson himself, to automatically adjust the vocal style, tone, and more. This makes it possible to recreate the vocals used in hits like "Shelter" or "Musician" with ease. The voicebank also supports new VOCALOID6 features, such as VOCALO CHANGER, which uses the creator's vocal data to replicate their own singing style as-is, and Multilingual, which makes it possible to sing lyrics in a mixture of fluent Japanese, English, and Chinese with a single voicebank.
